title: E2E: Protected routes redirect unauthenticated users
description: Playwright e2e test verifying that authenticated routes properly redirect to login and that public routes remain accessible.

acceptanceCriteria.text: Test: /dashboard redirects to /login when not authenticated
Test: /settings redirects to /login when not authenticated
Test: /leaderboard redirects to /login when not authenticated
Test: /song/:id is accessible without auth (public song pages)
Test: After login, user can access /dashboard
All tests pass: bun run test:e2e --grep 'auth-routes'
